list.legend_dir_hint: Green name = directory, click to enter
list.read_placeholder: Paste an article link (WeChat / web) to read aloud
list.upload_note: Select one or more files, then click upload. Files are saved to the current directory.

delete.dir_body: "{name}" contains files or subdirectories. Everything inside will be deleted permanently. Delete the entire directory?
delete.empty_dir_body: Delete empty directory "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
delete.file_body: Delete file "{name}"? This cannot be undone.

shell.hint: Terminal: Press Enter to run. Ctrl+C stops/clears, Ctrl+S searches history, Ctrl+L clears, Up/Down switches history. On mobile, use the top-right buttons. Scroll to review output; PageUp/PageDown page through it.
shell.placeholder: e.g. ls -la · du -sh * · find . -name xxx · cd docs
shell.path_outside: Path is outside the served directory

preview.download_title: Download original file (do not use the browser save option, or you will get .html)
preview.unsupported: This format cannot be previewed in the browser. Download it and open it locally.
preview.pdf_note: Displayed as PDF pages; links are clickable. Paging, zoom and search are supported. First conversion may take a few seconds.
preview.pages_note: Displayed as PDF pages; tables, images and layout match the original. {count} pages{more}. Each page takes about 1–2 seconds to load the first time.
preview.pdf_note2: Displayed as PDF; tables, images and layout match the original. First conversion may take a few seconds. Click Download to save the original.
preview.docx_note: Images are shown in document order. Only embedded .docx images are supported; complex layout may be simplified. Download for full fidelity.
preview.text_note: Text extracted; layout, images and table styles are not preserved. Download for full fidelity.
preview.permission_title: Cannot preview: file is not readable
preview.permission_message: The file exists, but the service account "{user}" cannot read it. Owner: {owner}, permissions: {mode}.
preview.permission_hint: If this is an opencode config file, it usually contains an API key. Do not preview or download it through the web UI; view it on the server with sudo.

article.url_placeholder: Paste a WeChat or web article link
article.not_webpage: Target is not a web page
article.internal_only: Only public http/https links are supported
article.private_address: Access to private addresses is not allowed
article.no_content: Could not identify article content (login required or unsupported page structure)

edit.title: Edit file
edit.note: Saving keeps a backup under cache/edit-backups. If the file changed on disk, the save is rejected.
edit.unsupported: This file cannot be edited in the browser.
edit.conflict: The file changed on disk after you opened it. Reload and try again.
edit.too_large: The file is too large to edit (limit: 2 MiB).
edit.not_text: This file does not look like text and cannot be edited.
